Krishna was in terrible pain, and only one cure could save him. But nobody would give it. As the story goes, one day in Dwarka, Krishna held his head and cried out. A headache no doctor could cure.

Narada asked, what will heal you, Lord? Krishna said, the dust from the feet of someone who truly loves me. Place it on my head. Narada ran to the queens. They gasped. Put our dust on God's head? That's a sin. Never.
Wait, did anyone help? Narada ran to Vrindavan. The gopis didn't think for a second. They scooped up dust from their feet. If it helps Krishna, let us carry the sin.
The moment it touched his head, the pain was gone. That's why the dust of Vrindavan is sacred. Love that forgets itself. Comment Radhe if you would give it too.
